adjudication.rationale: In `TopicRetriever#invalid_host?`, the host gate is `SiteSetting.embeddable_host != URI(@embed_url).host`. The new default for `embeddable_host` in `config/site_settings.yml` is an empty string (`''`). For `file://` URLs Ruby’s `URI(...).host` is `""` (empty string), so when the setting is effectively “unset” (`''`) `invalid_host?` returns false and retrieval proceeds. That can allow `fetch_http` to run and `TopicEmbed.import_remote` to call `open(url)` on a `file://` URL. The controller has its own blank-setting check, but `TopicRetriever` itself does not fail closed when the setting is blank, which is the condition described in the finding.
